scope: Opening Learn the skill guidance for all Level 7 and Level 8 lessons across six realms
findings: Level 8 opening guides previously reused short assessment-feedback steps without a key idea or transferable check.
Several fixed-seed examples did not directly teach their lesson title.
Selected Level 7 worked solutions skipped intermediate arithmetic, including decimal conversion, medians, ratios and transformations.
Conceptual examples sometimes referred to answer choices that the guide did not display.
A systematic-sampling practice variant could request a fractional name interval.
design: Teach the concept, demonstrate actual intermediate steps, then check or transfer the method.
Keep reviewed fixed examples and preserve matching existing visuals; replacements never inherit unrelated diagrams.
Keep valid Level 7 explanations and interactive fraction/decimal demonstrations.
Supply read-aloud text for added concepts, working, checks and conceptual choices.
Keep practice entry and progression unchanged.
regressionCheck: npm run qa:upper-skill-guides (also required by prebuild)
testLimits: Automated rendering stubs artwork and speech playback: it verifies supplied speech text, not audible pronunciation.
Example signatures detect content drift; they are not proof of pedagogical quality. Future content edits still require mathematical and teaching review.
This audit is of lesson-opening guides, not a fresh review of every generated practice or assessment variant. Existing practice QA additionally checks 9900 Level 8 questions.
